verdict.rationale: Granola documents some event-triggered automations of its own: notes added to folders auto-sync to HubSpot records, follow-up emails are drafted automatically after external meetings, and the API exposes webhook-endpoints. Its official Zapier integration lets users automate what happens after a meeting. However, there is no evidence of a native, general-purpose rule builder where users define their own event-to-action rules; most custom logic depends on Zapier or the API. Missing for 10: a native user-defined rules/trigger builder, documentation of the available trigger events and conditions, details on webhook event types, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
